system.description:
Range: 10 spaces

You give a creature the shape that suits it best, whether or not it desires your help

Choose yourself or a creature within 10 spaces. An unwilling creature may make a Resilience check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics) to refuse.

Until the start of your next turn, the target grows one of the following:

  • Long Arms — The target's Melee and the Range of its Melee attacks increase by +1, and its Defense decreases by -1.

  • Armored Carapace — The target's Armor increases by +2, and its speed is reduced by half, rounded up.

  • Environmental Adaptation — The target gains +5 to a Speed of your choice, and no longer needs to breathe.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect, keeping the same mutation.
